recipes.title: Blueberry Overnight Oats
recipes.description: Oats, yoghurt and blueberries ready straight from the fridge.

steps.text: Stir the oats, milk, yoghurt and maple syrup together in a jar.
Cover and refrigerate overnight. Stir again and top with blueberries before serving.

recipes.notes: Loosen with a splash of milk if the oats are too thick.
